about_the_game:
Secrets of Antares is a walking (and flying) simulator built for one purpose: peaceful exploration. No combat, no crafting, no objectives — just you, a jetpack, and an alien world of stunning beauty. This is not a game about action. It’s about being.

Walk or fly at your own pace through a breathtaking alien paradise orbiting the red supergiant Antares. Designed entirely for relaxation, you don’t interact with objects, fight enemies, or solve puzzles. In fact, you don’t even need to use your hands most of the time — just move, breathe, and exist in a world crafted for calm.

Key Features:

  • Pure Exploration: No goals, no tasks. Just move freely and absorb the world around you. This is a game for those who want to wander.

  • Jetpack Freedom: Walk, hover, or soar across vast biomes with a smooth, intuitive jetpack system. Upgrades extend your range, letting you reach distant mountaintops and floating islands.

  • Unreal Visuals: Powered by next-gen VR graphics, every vista is designed to feel like a living, alien painting. Forests, oceans, mountains, and bioluminescent caves stretch out before you in photorealistic beauty.

  • A True VR Retreat: No hand interaction required. Sit back, drift through the world, and let your mind rest. Perfect for ending the day or escaping into something quiet and meditative.

  • Find Your Place: Whether it’s a beach under twin moons, a floating island above the clouds, or a cave glowing with alien light, Antares is filled with serene spots to simply exist.

  • Dynamic Atmosphere: Enjoy a beautiful day/night cycle, complete with vivid alien sunsets and star-filled skies. Watch time pass in a world untouched by conflict.

If you want a game where you can just chill, breathe, and enjoy being somewhere beautiful — Secrets of Antares is made for you.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12400F or AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA 2080 or AMD 7700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 120 GB available space
  • VR Support: Quest 2, Quest 3, Valve Index, Mixed Reality, Vive
  • Additional Notes: SSD and strong VR legs required
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 13700 or AMD Ryzen 9 7900X
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA 4070 or AMD 7900XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 120 GB available space
  • VR Support: Quest 2, Quest 3, Valve Index, Mixed Reality, Vive
  • Additional Notes: SSD and strong VR legs required

short_description: Explore a stunning alien world with nothing but your jetpack and curiosity. No combat, no puzzles—just peaceful walking and flying in VR. Secrets of Antares is a relaxing escape built for pure exploration and breathtaking visuals.
